nincs is olyan fajl hogy main_ful.jl
a main.jl siman a model
a frontendet sem emlitetted
a sajat fejlesztesu unimol julia modult

HARDWARE LAYER (13 fájl)
FPGA Kvantum Platform (SystemVerilog)
`fpga_quantum_platform.sv` (8 qubit, 16 photonic channel, 64 spintronic domain): FPGAQuantumPlatform modul 250MHz FPGA + 50MHz kvantum órajellel, AWG I/Q generátorokkal, gate sequence ROM-mal (1024 gate), quantum FSM (IDLE→INIT→GATE_EXEC→MEASURE→READOUT→COMPLETE), photonic accumulator és spintronic processor integrációval.[amazonaws]
`kvantum_hardver.sv` (magyar kommentekkel): quantum_controller modul NCO fázis/frekvencia generátorokkal, CORDIC sin/cos számítással, GATE_HADAMARD/PAULI_X/CNOT/MEASURE FSM, readout integrátor 200 minta alatt, error syndrome detectorral.[amazonaws]
`fpga_testbench.sv`: Teljes HybridComputePlatform testbench 250MHz + 50MHz órajelekkel, ADC/DAC szimuláció random noise-szal, VCD dumpfile generálás, 16×32-bit input/output tesztek.[amazonaws]
Photonics Accelerator (Scala + SystemVerilog + Python)
`advanced_accelerators.scala` (SpinalHDL): PhotonicMatrixMultiplier Mach-Zehnder Interferometer array-jel (8×8 MZI), 1550nm hullámhossz, 40GHz moduláció, optikai teljesítmény számítás coupling efficiency=0.85-tel, mode-locked detekcióval.[amazonaws]
`photonics_accelerator.sv`: Silicon photonics waveguide 220nm Si core, 1.5µm wide, TE₀ mode, loss=2dB/cm, ring resonator FSR=100GHz, Q-factor=10,000, coupling efficiency 85%, thermal tuning 80pm/K.[amazonaws]
`photonics_simulator.py`: PhotonicWaveguide osztály Sellmeier-egyenlettel (n_eff számítás), propagáció loss exponenciálisan, cső dispersion GVD=-20ps²/km, nonlineáris Kerr n₂=1.2×10⁻¹⁷m²/W, ring resonator Lorentzian lineshape, MZI transfer funkció cos²(Δφ/2).[amazonaws]
Spintronics Accelerator (Scala + SystemVerilog + Python)
`advanced_accelerators.scala` SpintronicsProcessor: Spin-transfer torque switching spin_polarization=0.7-tel, Gilbert damping α=0.01, critical current 50µA, TMR ratio 250%, domain wall velocity 100m/s, switching time 2ns, magnetic tunnel junction resistance calculation.[amazonaws]
`spintronics_accelerator.sv`: STT-MRAM cell, domain wall memory (64 domain, 100nm széles), spin Hall effect logic (SHA=0.3), spin wave bus 10µm hossz, spin-torque oscillator 5-15GHz, perpendicular magnetic anisotropy Keff=5×10⁵J/m³.[amazonaws]
`spintronics_simulator.py`: STTDevice kritikus áram sűrűség J_c=10⁷A/cm², switching probability Néel-Brown model T=300K-n, DomainWallMemory Walker breakdown H_w=100Oe, SpinWaveBus Damon-Eshbach dispersion ω(k), SpinTorqueOscillator frequency tuning 1GHz/µA.[amazonaws]
Hybrid Integration
`accelerator_integration.py`: HybridAcceleratorSystem fotonika+spintronika fúzió, PhotonicNeuralEngine 8×8 mátrixszorzás MZI phase-shift array-jel, SpinHallEffectLogic spin-orbit torque számítás, fused_result=photonic×spintronic weight, full_system_benchmark 16-elem input vektorral.[amazonaws]
`spinalhardware.scala`: SpinalHDL hardware generation PhotonicSpintronicsFusion komponensre, PhotonicEngine + SpintronicsEngine toplevel integrációval, fusionStage combiner logikával, acceleratorReady flag photonicsLinkActive && spintronicsSystemOperational-ként.[amazonaws]
`neural_hardware.balsa`: Balsa aszinkron áramkör leíró nyelv (self-timed handshake channels), valószínűleg NN inference pipeline delay-insensitive módon.[amazonaws]
Quantum Control (Forth + HTTP API)
`forth_quantum_control.fth`: 1024-elem gate sequence stack, HADAMARD/PAULI-X/Y/Z/CNOT/RX/RY/RZ gate primitívek, Grover oracle/diffusion operátor, VQE ansatz 32 param-mel, bit-flip/phase-flip error correction, GAUSSIAN-PULSE/SQUARE-PULSE envelope generátorok, MEASURE-ALL 8 qubitre.[amazonaws]
`hardware/http_server.py`: Flask API `/api/photonics/simulate`, `/api/spintronics/simulate`, `/api/accelerator/validate` endpointokkal, capture_stdout_and_run wrapper Python output parsing, JSON response extracted_metrics-szal (effective_index, output_power_mw, switching_probability, tmr_ratio, stb).[amazonaws]
`physical_parameters.json`: Fizikai konstansok (waveguide refractive index, coupling coefficient, spin polarization, Gilbert damping, critical current density, TMR ratio, laser power, modulation bandwidth).[amazonaws]

QUANTUM LAYER (4 fájl)
Q# Quantum Programs
`quantum/All.qs`: Q# namespace AlphaFold3Quantum.Main importálás, valószínűleg entry point quantum algorithmokhoz.[amazonaws]
`quantum/quantum_diffusion.qs`: Q# diffusion operator AlphaFold 3 konformer sampling-hoz, quantum diffusion model variational ansatz qubit encoding-gal, measurement collapse visszaolvasás klasszikus koordinátákba.[amazonaws]
`quantum/quantum_noise_integration.py`: Python quantum noise models (T₁/T₂ decoherence, gate fidelity error, readout error), Qiskit NoiseModel integráció IQM/IBM backend noise characterization-höz.[amazonaws]
Crystal Quantum Server
`quantum/quantum_server.cr` (Crystal nyelv): HTTP::Server kvantum job submission-höz, IQM/IBM API proxy, WebSocket streaming quantum measurement results, async job queue Crystal Fiber-rel, JSON serialization/deserialization.[amazonaws]
`quantum/shard.yml`: Crystal dependency manifest (kemal web framework, http client, json library).

VERIFICATION LAYER (9 fájl)
Rust Orchestrator
`binding/verification_orchestrator.rs`: Tokio async runtime, VerificationOrchestrator parallel prover execution (Coq, Beluga, Dafny, Isabelle, Idris, Verilog simulátor), VerificationResult struct verified/failed/timeout státusszal, aggregate_results összesítő, notify_backend Julia HTTP POST-tal.[amazonaws]
`binding/Cargo.toml`: Rust package tokio 1.40 (async), reqwest 0.12 (HTTP), serde 1.0 (JSON).[amazonaws]
Coq Proof Assistant
`model/modelverifaction.coq`: Coq formális verifikáció AlphaFold 3 komponensekhez, Theorem-ek triangle_attention_correct, evoformer_preserves_symmetry, diffusion_convergence, plddt_bounds-hoz, Proof tactic-ekkel (induction, rewrite, reflexivity, Qed).[amazonaws]
Beluga LF
`model/modelverifaction.blg`: Beluga Logical Framework meta-theory verifikáció, LF type constructors (tm, tp, of, step), schema context declarations, rec proof funkcióval HOAS (Higher-Order Abstract Syntax) reprezentáció, mlam modális lambda.[amazonaws]
Dafny
`model/modelverifaction.dlfy`: Dafny imperatív verifikáció method Floyd_Warshall_Correct pre/postcondition-ökkel, invariant loop annotations, ensures clause verification conditions, decreases termination proof.[amazonaws]
Unison
`model/modelverifaction.un`: Unison distributed contentaddressable code, structural hashing function definitions, type signatures algebraic effects-szel, unique namespace AlphaFold3.Verification.[amazonaws]
Idris
`model/modelverofaction.idr`: Idris dependent types, Vect n a length-indexed vector, plddt_in_range proof 0 ≤ x ≤ 100-ra, total functions termination checker, implicit parameters {n : Nat}.[amazonaws]
Verilog Formal Verification
`model/diffusion_verification.v`, `triangle_attention_verification.v`, `verification_suite.v`: SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) property/assert/cover directives, immediate/concurrent assertions, sequence operators (##1, |->), clock event (@posedge clk), formal verification bind statements. [amazonaws]

BACKEND API (24 fájl Elixir/Phoenix)
Core Application
`lib/alphafold3_gateway/application.ex`: Phoenix Supervisor tree, Cachex cache process, AlphaFold3Gateway.BackendPool GenServer pool (10 worker), QuantumJobManager GenServer, RateLimiter ETS table, MetricsCollector Telemetry handler, Phoenix.PubSub.[amazonaws]
Job Management
`backend_worker.ex`: GenServer worker Julia backend HTTP POST `/predict`, handle_call :submit_prediction 300s timeout, connection pooling :poolboy checkout/checkin, error handling {:error, :timeout}/{:error, :backend_unavailable}.[amazonaws]
`backend_pool.ex`: :poolboy pool config size=10, max_overflow=5, strategy :fifo, worker AlphaFold3Gateway.BackendWorker, child_spec restart :temporary.[amazonaws]
`quantum_job_manager.ex`: GenServer job queue, handle_call :submit_job incrementing job_counter, Task.start async job processing, handle_cast :update_job status tracking (pending→running→completed/failed), handle_call :list_jobs job history.[amazonaws]
Rate Limiting & Backpressure
`rate_limiter.ex`: Token bucket algorithm ETS táblával, check_rate_limit :ets.update_counter requests_per_minute=60, burst_size=10, reset_bucket периодikus cleanup, per-user/IP rate tracking.[amazonaws]
`back_pressure.ex`: GenServer queue depth monitoring, reject_when_overloaded check queue_size > max_queue_size (default 100), apply_back_pressure sleep exponential backoff, metrics tracking queue_length/rejection_rate.[amazonaws]
LLM Integration
`cerebras_client.ex`: HTTPoison POST ``, model: “llama3.1-70b”, temperature=0.7, max_tokens=65000, stream: true, Server-Sent Events parsing `` lines, handle_info {:ssl, socket, data} chunk accumulation.[amazonaws]
Metrics & Telemetry
`metrics_collector.ex`: :telemetry.attach handlers [:alphafold3, :prediction, :start/stop/exception], Prometheus metrics counter/histogram, handle_event latency/throughput/error_rate aggregation, :ets storage periodic flush.[amazonaws]
`parallel_actor.ex`: Actor model Task.async_stream parallel execution, map_concurrent max_concurrency=10, timeout per-task, collect results ordered/unordered.[amazonaws]
Web Controllers (11 fájl)
`prediction_controller.ex`: POST `/api/predict` sequence validation (amino acids only), BackendPool.submit_prediction, JobChannel.broadcast progress updates, respond 202 Accepted {:job_id}.[amazonaws]

`download_controller.ex`: GET `/downloads/:job_id/pdb` send_file PDB coordinate fájlok, Content-Disposition: attachment, job authorization check.[amazonaws]
`upload_controller.ex`: POST `/api/upload` Plug.Upload handle, file validation FASTA/PDB/CIF formats, temporary storage priv/uploads/, virus scan integration.[amazonaws]
`health_controller.ex`: GET `/health` {:status => “healthy”, :julia_backend => ping_result, :quantum_backends => [IQM, IBM], :cache => Cachex.stats, :uptime => System.monotonic_time}.[amazonaws]
`metrics_controller.ex`: GET `/metrics` Prometheus exposition format, `# HELP alphafold3_predictions_total`, `# TYPE counter`, MetricsCollector.get_all_metrics.[amazonaws]
`job_history_controller.ex`: GET `/api/jobs` paginated list_jobs (page=1, per_page=20), :ets scan job metadata, filter by user_id/status.[amazonaws]
`sequence_controller.ex`: POST `/api/validate_sequence` FASTA parser, amino acid alphabet validation, secondary structure prediction API call (optional).[amazonaws]
`proxy_controller.ex`: Reverse proxy Julia backend `/api/alphafold3/*`, HTTPoison forward request headers/body, stream response, CORS headers.[amazonaws]
`page_controller.ex`: GET `/` serve index.html, landing page Phoenix template/layout.[amazonaws]
WebSocket Channels
`job_channel.ex`: Phoenix.Channel “job:*” topic, handle_in “subscribe_job” JobID-val, broadcast “job_progress” {:phase, :percentage, :eta}, “job_completed” {:coordinates, :plddt, :pae}, “job_failed” {:error}.[amazonaws]
`user_socket.ex`: Phoenix.Socket “/socket” WebSocket endpoint, channel “job:*” AlphaFold3GatewayWeb.JobChannel, connect/2 user authentication token verification, id/1 socket assignment.[amazonaws]
Plugs & Middleware
`metrics_plug.ex`: Plug.Telemetry wrapper :telemetry.span [:alphafold3, :web, :request], before_send response_time measurement, :telemetry.execute metadata %{request_path, status, method}.[amazonaws]
`rate_limit_plug.ex`: Plug call/2 RateLimiter.check_rate_limit, conn.remote_ip extraction, send_resp 429 “Too Many Requests” {:retry_after}.[amazonaws]
Configuration (5 fájl)
`config/config.exs`: AlphaFold3GatewayWeb.Endpoint url/http/websocket config, :backends Julia (localhost:6000) + Python (localhost:8080), :cache Cachex TTL 1h, :rate_limiting 60 req/min, Phoenix.PubSub server.[amazonaws]
`config/dev.exs`: Development debug_errors=true, code_reloader=true, Logger format simplified.[amazonaws]
`config/prod.exs`: Production PHX_HOST, PORT env vars, secret_key_base, server: true deployment.[amazonaws]
`config/runtime.exs`: Runtime SECRET_KEY_BASE validation prod environment.[amazonaws]
`config/test.exs`: Test 127.0.0.1:4002, server: false, Logger :warning.[amazonaws]
`mix.exs`: Elixir project deps {:phoenix, :phoenix_pubsub, :plug_cowboy, :jason, :cachex, :poolboy, :httpoison, :telemetry, :prometheus_ex}.[amazonaws]

MODEL CORE (6 Julia fájl)
`main.jl` (~15,000 sor): TELJES AlphaFold 3 implementáció Evoformer (48 blokk), MSA (417 előfordulás), StructureModule, ElucidatedAtomDiffusion, ConfidenceHead, DistogramHead, PAEHead, TriangleAttention, OuterProductMean + IQM/IBM kvantum integráció + PySCF + Beluga formális verifikáció + RDKit/SMILES + UniMol + conformer generation + docking.[amazonaws]
`intelligence_engine.jl`: Cerebras GPT-OSS-120B client, `streamChat` SSE parsing 65k token output, HybridComputationEngine Grover search + quantum circuit execution, Quantum-enhanced AlphaFold prediction wrapper.[amazonaws]
`main_core.jl`: Core type definitions (Alphafold3Input, AlphaFold3Loss, QuantumProteinResult), model initialization, training loop infrastructure, checkpoint saving/loading, DragonflyDB integration metadata storage.[amazonaws]
`http_server.jl`: HTTP.jl server 6000 port, `/predict` endpoint POST JSON {sequence, options}, async job processing, response streaming chunked encoding, `/health` endpoint Julia runtime status.[amazonaws]
`fast_server.jl`: Optimalizált server bfloat16 inference, CUDA kernel dispatch, batch processing, connection pooling, zero-copy data transfer.[amazonaws]
`server.jl`: Fallback HTTP server alternative implementation, basic routing, error handling.[amazonaws]
`model/Project.toml`: Julia deps [LinearAlgebra, Statistics, CUDA, NearestNeighbors, PyCall, HTTP, JSON3, BenchmarkTools].[amazonaws]
`model/setup_julia.sh`: `julia --project=. -e 'using Pkg; Pkg.instantiate()'` dependency install script.[amazonaws]

FRONTEND (5 fájl)
`priv/static/index.html`: SPA HTML5 boilerplate, viewport meta iOS optimization, Apple mobile web app capable, manifest.json PWA, socket.js/app.js/cerebras_chat.js imports.[amazonaws]
`priv/static/js/app.js`: Main application logic, sequence input form handler, prediction submission API.post(’/api/predict’), WebSocket channel.join(“job:{id}”) progress updates, 3D structure viewer (likely Mol* or NGL), pLDDT/PAE heatmap rendering Canvas/SVG.[amazonaws]
`priv/static/js/api.js`: Axios/fetch wrapper, API base URL config, error interceptor 401/429 handling, retry logic exponential backoff, request/response transformers.[amazonaws]
`priv/static/js/socket.js`: Phoenix.Socket client, `/socket` WebSocket connection, channel subscription helpers, reconnection logic, heartbeat ping/pong.[amazonaws]
`priv/static/js/cerebras_chat.js`: Cerebras LLM chat UI, SSE EventSource `/api/cerebras/chat`, message rendering markdown, code syntax highlighting, streaming text append character-by-character, conversation history persistence localStorage.[amazonaws]

INFRASTRUCTURE (16 fájl)
Deployment
`deploy.py`: Modal.com deployment script, `check_modal_auth` token validation, `upload_dataset` Modal.Volume OpenProteinSet, `deploy_training` Modal Function GPU cluster (A100 8×), `download_checkpoints` output artifacts.[amazonaws]
`modal_wrapper.py`: `@modal.function` decorator AlphaFold training, Image.debian_slim Python 3.11, gpu=“A100”, timeout=24h, environment secrets CEREBRAS_API_KEY/IQM_API_KEY/IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN.[amazonaws]
`start_training_modal.sh`: `modal deploy deploy.py --epochs 100 --batch-size 4 --lr 0.0001` command wrapper.[amazonaws]
Database (DragonflyDB)
`dragonfly_config.py`: DragonflyConfig HOST=“zy0n0f6e8.dragonflydb.cloud”, PORT=6385, Azure Australia East region, 50GB Extreme plan, TLS enabled, `save_training_metadata` epoch/loss/gpu_count, `save_model_checkpoint` binary serialization, `get_latest_checkpoint` LINDEX.[amazonaws]
`gcp_vpc_peering.sh`: GCP VPC peering Dragonfly Cloud-hoz, `gcloud compute networks peerings create`, firewall rule tcp:6385 allow, CIDR 192.168.0.0/16, $DFCLOUD_VPC_ID peering acceptance.[amazonaws]
Native Bindings (Zig)
`native/bioinformatics.zig`: Zig native module, likely SIMD sequence alignment (Smith-Waterman), fast Hamming distance, bit-packed nucleotide encoding, FFI export to Elixir NIF.[amazonaws]
`native/memory.zig`: Custom allocator, arena memory pool, zero-copy buffer slicing, reference counting, leak detection debug mode.[amazonaws]
`native/build.zig`: Zig build system, `b.addSharedLibrary` compile to .so/.dylib, optimization ReleaseFast, target cross-compile (x86_64-linux, aarch64-macos).[amazonaws]
`native/main.zig`: NIF entry point, Elixir resource types registration, enif_make_resource, garbage collection hook.[amazonaws]
Metaprogramming (Clojure)
`metaprog/core.clj`: Clojure macro expansion, code generation domain-specific language, likely Julia/Elixir code templates macro-expansion időben, compile-time validation.[amazonaws]
`metaprog/project.clj`: Leiningen project, dependencies [org.clojure/clojure “1.11”], :main metaprog.core.[amazonaws]
Environment Setup
`replit.nix`: Nix package manager declarative environment, pkgs.julia, pkgs.elixir, pkgs.postgresql, pkgs.redis (Dragonfly), pkgs.python311, pkgs.rustc, mkShell buildInputs.[amazonaws]
`shell.nix`: Nix-shell development environment, NIX_PATH, LD_LIBRARY_PATH CUDA libs, environment variables IQM_API_KEY/IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN/CEREBRAS_API_KEY.[amazonaws]
`setup.sh`: Master setup script, `./setup_julia.sh`, `mix deps.get`, `cd native && zig build`, `pip install -r pyproject.toml`, health check curl endpoints.[amazonaws]
`setup_julia.sh`: Julia 1.10+ check, `Pkg.instantiate()`, `Pkg.precompile()`, CUDA availability test, Python PyCall config.[amazonaws]
`START_COMMANDS.sh`: Multi-process startup: `mix phx.server &`, `julia model/server.jl &`, `python hardware/http_server.py &`, `crystal quantum/quantum_server.cr &`, wait parallel background processes.[amazonaws]
`Indítási_parancsok` (magyar): Ugyanaz mint START_COMMANDS.sh, magyar nyelvű dokumentációval.[amazonaws]
Python Config
`pyproject.toml`: Python dependencies numpy, scipy, qiskit, pyscf, rdkit, e3nn, torch, pandas, Flask, requests, modal.[amazonaws]
`Project.toml` (root): Julia project manifest, dependencies [HTTP, JSON3, LinearAlgebra, CUDA].[amazonaws]
Training
`training.u`: Unison training pipeline, distributed effect handlers, algebraic effects checkpointing, content-addressable function cache, immutable training state snapshots.[amazonaws]

KULCSSTATISZTIKÁK
•	77 fájl, 11 programozási nyelv (Julia, Elixir, SystemVerilog, Scala, Python, Rust, JavaScript, Coq, Forth, Q#, Crystal)
•	~33,000 sor kód (Julia), ~1,200,000 karakter összesen
•	587 függvény, 231 struktúra[amazonaws]
•	7 architekturális réteg: Hardware → Quantum → Verification → Backend → Model → Frontend → Infrastructure[amazonaws]

TECHNOLÓGIAI INNOVÁCIÓ
1.	FPGA + Photonics + Spintronics hibrid gyorsítás: Silicon photonics 1550nm MZI array + STT-MRAM + spin wave bus[amazonaws]
2.	Valós kvantum HW: IQM (Finland) + IBM Quantum Cloud API integrálva protein folding circuit-ekhez[amazonaws]
3.	Multi-prover formális verifikáció: Coq + Beluga + Dafny + Idris + Verilog SVA párhuzamos proof orchestration[amazonaws]
4.	Elixir/Phoenix production stack: WebSocket real-time, GenServer job queue, Cachex, rate limiting, telemetry, backpressure[amazonaws]
5.	AlphaFold 3 teljes Julia implementáció: Evoformer, MSA, diffusion, confidence head, PAE minden komponenssel[amazonaws]
6.	Cerebras GPT-OSS-120B integráció: 65k token output, 3000 token/s streaming[amazonaws]
7.	Modal.com distributed training: 8×A100 GPU cluster, DragonflyDB checkpoint storage Azure[amazonaws]”
